Alex: Heads-up — instructor conflict for next SI lab week. Need backup instructor and sandbox creds, cc @Maria @Jess.
Maria: Which lab and dates? Is this the model-deploy + kms hands-on?
Alex: Yup — Apr 13-15, 09:00-13:00 PST daily. Tao double-booked with a client workshop.
Jess: I can cover mornings on Tue/Thu but need the latest lab guide, slides, and an env reset script. Where are the materials?
Alex: Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/si-labs/v3 — main folder has slides + lab guide. Also need extra sandbox quota for GPUs (we burnt through last time).
Rodrigo: I'll open a partner sandbox request today for +10 GPU seats. Ticket: PRJ-4821. ETA ~48h from now.
Maria: We should freeze the cert exam content before the bootcamp launches. Last cohort had drift between labs and exam questions.
Tao: Sorry team, my bad on double-booking. I can record a 20m walkthrough and leave handover notes if that helps.
onboard-bot: Auto: Calendar event created — "SI Lab: Model Deploy" Apr 13 09:00-13:00 PST. Event ID: cal_0x9f7a
Jess: I tried provisioning a test account: jess@redwood.test — blocked on IAM role missing `kms:Decrypt`.
Alex: Quick fix in runbook: to re-provision the lab run:
```
./scripts/provision_lab.sh --env=staging --reset --skip-demo-data
```
That will recreate the KMS keys binding step.
Maria: Also proposal: add a 15-question practice exam + automated badge issuance flow. Badge should be minted on passing and pushed to the partner LMS.
Jess: :thumbsup: I'll draft the practice exam and the slide updates. Target: draft by Thu noon so we can iterate.
Rodrigo: Badge infra note — Badgebot needs: webhook endpoint, a service account with repo:write, and a short verification hook. I'll scope in PRJ-4821.
Alex: Can marketing get a hold of final slide deck + exam copy by EOD Friday for the joint announcement blurb?
Jess: Confirmed — slides + exam draft by Thu noon, final by Fri EOD.
Maria: Summary/owners: backup instructor = Jess, sandbox GPU ticket = PRJ-4821 (Rodrigo), proctor checklist = Maria, exam + slides = Jess, badge infra = Rodrigo. Thanks all :sparkles:
